_comment: The coverage slot registry. Data, not code: changing the wording of a
question must never mean touching a schema or a state machine.
Question order is the topological order of depends_on, ties broken by the
order of this list. That is what makes the interview reproducible for a
given registry version, which is what the determinism tests assert.
class decides escalation (see the rule in discovery.py, mirroring IDE-68
6.3). closable_by says who is allowed to close the slot at all.
lookup_first names the cheap sources that must be consulted before the
Product Owner's attention is spent - a refusal to ask what the repository

slots.closes_when: the problem and whose it is are stated without naming a solution
the difference in the world after this ships is stated
the people affected are named, not described as 'users'
what is being built is stated as product behaviour
what is deliberately not being done is listed
slots._why_required: An empty non-goals list is the single most common discovery defect. It is rejected, never defaulted.

slots.closes_when: at least one FR-n exists and each is a statement about behaviour
stated with numbers, or dismissed on the record
the technical and organisational limits are known
each assumption is marked validated with evidence, or left explicit
what this needs from elsewhere is known
someone could write a test from each one without asking what was meant
a metric, its baseline and its target are stated
never asked as a question; filled by the evidence command
written by the script from Product Owner answers only
written by the script from what remains unresolved
